verdict.rationale: Brave Search API offers AI-generated summaries, answers, and location descriptions grounded in real-time web search (docs-16, docs-17, docs-27, docs-10), fitting the 'AI-generated insights' story. However, community evidence shows the free-tier ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate paid AI Inference plan to legitimately use these features with agents, which is a significant caveat not clearly resolved in the vendor docs.
